The good events (G1)-(G5) (numbered alike in the three runs; a run need not use all five), invariants (Inv1)-(Inv3), path properties (P1)-(P4) (and (P5) in PV) are local to the run and unrelated to the galactic conditions (Gamma k). Symbols local to one estimate (chi, K_{j,c}, V', I_u) are italic. No symbol has a meaning outside its run. The per-run VALUES differ: TPV: J = floor(log2(L/6)), k = 3J+1 colours, m = ceil(L^6), b = ceil(2^8 L^2 m), t = 2^10 L^8, kappa in {0,1,2,3} with law (1/2,1/6,1/6,1/6), levels only on P; PV: J = floor(log2(L/8)), no colouring (4J+1 own classes are given), m = ceil(L^6), b = ceil(2^7 L^2 m), t = 2^9 L^8, kappa in {0,...,4} with law (1/2,1/8,1/8,1/8,1/8), levels only on Pl; VX+: J = floor(log2(L/6)), k = 3J+1, m = ceil(L^3), b = ceil(2 m L^2/eps_O), t = 2^8 L^5 (eps_O = 2^-5) or 2^9 L^5 (eps_O = 2^-6), kappa as in TPV, levels on all of Z. noncomputable def etaTPV (N : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.logb 2 N * N ^ (-5 : ℤ) + 2 ^ 96 * Real.logb 2 N ^ 31 * N ^ (-3 : ℤ)
    + N * Real.logb 2 N * Real.exp (-(3 * Real.logb 2 N ^ 4 / 8))

  2 * Real.logb 2 N * N ^ (-5 : ℤ) + 2 ^ 95 * Real.logb 2 N ^ 28 * N ^ (-3 : ℤ)
    + N * Real.logb 2 N * Real.exp (-(3 * Real.logb 2 N ^ 2 / (32 * Real.logb 2 (Real.logb 2 N))))

label: s4:lemTPV
name: Lemma TPV (transparent P-vortex)
ms_status: x2+RT; per-step bound (s4:eqTPVstep), finish and final count changed in v6 (R1): no referee yet; level law truncated, (G2) re-proved via (MC), (B) re-proved in v6 (R5): no referee yet
formalization: Spec (deterministic form, recommended Tier-1) EG/Spec/Vortex/TPV.lean: TPVStatement; proof EG/Proof/Vortex/TPV.lean from a Lib probabilistic core (good event of positive probability) and a Lib deterministic engine shared with PV and VX+ (EG/Lib/Vortex/{Trail,Ends,MonoComp,Labels,Step}.lean)
statement: HYPOTHESES. V a type with decidable equality; Z a finite vertex set, N := |Z|, L := log_2 N; N >= N0 (Lean: TPVSize N, i.e. L >= 2^10, N >= L^3, eta_TPV(N) <= 1/100; these are the size conditions (i)-(iv) of the proof); O a graph with V(O) = Z that is an (eps_O, s)-expander (Def 11), 2^-7 <= eps_O <= 2^-5 (only the lower bound is used), s >= 2^150 L^42 (reals); Z = P + Q a partition (P ⊆ Z arbitrary, Q := Z \ P). PARAMETERS: J := floor(log2(L/6)), k := 3J+1, m := ceil(L^6), b := ceil(2^8 L^2 m) (the HB bound at the worst case eps_O = 2^-7), t := 2^10 L^8. A family A(w) ⊆ N_O(w), |A(w)| = m, each vertex in at most b of the A(w) (w in Z), fixed as a function of O (exists by s3:lemHB with eps' = eps_O, m; 2m <= s). LABELS (independent): (a) a uniform colouring of E(O) with the k colours R_{j,c} (0 <= j < J, c in [3]) and M; (b) for v in P a level lev(v) in {0..J} with P(lev >= j) = 2^-j (0 <= j <= J); (c) for v in Z a label kappa(v) in {0,1,2,3}, P(0) = 1/2, P(c) = 1/6. SETS: U_j := Q u {v in P : lev v >= j}, W_j := {v in P : lev v = j}, Z_j := {u in U_{j+1} : kappa u = 0}, V_{j,c} := {u in U_{j+1} : kappa u = c}. CLAIM: there EXISTS an event G (a set of label outcomes), determined by (Z, O, P) and the labels, with P(G) >= 1/2 - eta_TPV(N), eta_TPV(N) := 2 L N^-5 + 2^96 L^31 N^-3 + N L e^{-3L^4/8} <= 1/100, such that for EVERY outcome in G and EVERY edge set E of a simple graph (no loops) with E(O) ⊆ E and all ends of all edges in Z, there EXISTS a partition E = E^V + E^Q with (T1) every edge of E with both ends in P lies in E^V; (T2) every edge of E^V with an end in Q is an edge of O; (T3) E^V has a decomposition into at most 169|P| objects (cycles of length >= 3 and single edges), and E^V = ∅ if P = ∅; (T4) all these objects consist of edges of E and no open path ('arc') is left. Meta-claim: partition and decomposition are a deterministic function of (E, labels). LOGICAL CONTENT (important for the Spec): the conclusion (T1)-(T4) does not mention the labels, and P(G) >= 1/2 - 1/100 > 0 forces G ≠ ∅; hence, given the hypotheses, the lemma is EQUIVALENT to the deterministic statement 'for every admissible E there is E^V ⊆ E with (T1)-(T3)' (the ∃G form follows back by taking G := whole space). The explicit good event of the proof is G := (G1) ∩ (G2) ∩ (G4) ∩ (G5): (G1) all k colour classes are spanning (eps_O, s/(2k))-expanders; (G2) every R_{j,c} is (2^12 L^4, t)-path connected through V_{j,c}; (G4) for all j < J and w in P, C^j_w := {wu : u in A(w), wu in M, u in Z_j} has >= 6 elements; (G5) sum_{j<J} |P ∩ U_j| <= 8|P| and |P ∩ U_J| <= 48|P|/L. Proof outline: steps j = 0..J-1 (reserve 6 M-edges per w in W_j; classes avoiding kappa of the far end; Corollary-22 decomposition per class; append reserved edges / cherries; split trails by (S); close each remaining path by a connector of R_{j,c} through V_{j,c} using (G2) and (C)); invariants (Inv1)-(Inv3); cost 12|W_j| + 9|P ∩ U_j| per step, 84|P| in total; finish by Fact EG0(b) with beta = 48, alpha = |P|: <= 48|P|; total 132|P| <= 169|P|. Includes the five observations (S) trail splitting, (E) path ends, (MC) monotone comparison, (B) binomial domination, (C) closing (s4.tex:46-133; named labels s4:eqSplit, s4:eqEnds, s4:eqMono, s4:eqDom, s4:eqClose; they are parts of this proof, not separate statements).

hazards.label: TPV-DET-SPEC
hazards.description: The literal statement 'there is an event G with P(G) >= 1/2 - eta such that on G, for every E, ...' has a conclusion that does not mention the labels, so it is logically equivalent (given eta < 1/2) to the deterministic claim 'for every admissible E there is E^V with (T1)-(T3)'; conversely the ∃G form follows from the deterministic claim with G := the whole space, i.e. an ∃G Spec carries no more content than the deterministic one and would mislead reviewers. The only consumer use of the probability is non-emptiness (s7:lemOneOutcome: 'only this non-emptiness is used'; s5:lemChild/lemDemoted: '>= 1/3'). DECISION NEEDED (integrator, before locking s5-s7 Specs): lock the deterministic TPVStatement, keep the explicit good event and its probability bound as Lib lemmas, and remove the TPV/PV/VX+ stage-3 labels from s5:lemChild, s5:lemDemoted, s6:consOrder, s7:defSchedule and s7:lemOneOutcome (they become deterministic applications). The 'deterministic procedure' meta-claim is realised by Classical.choose on the ∀E∃ statement (a function of E only), which is what the s6/s7 'past is a deterministic function' arguments need.

hazards.description: The deterministic part (steps (i)-(vi) over J steps, invariants (Inv1)-(Inv3), 'an edge is used once it is placed', edge-disjointness of trails/cherries/single edges/connectors across the 3 classes, coverage of F_j, the finish) is written informally with 'fixed rules' and has no Mathlib support: list surgery on vertex lists with Sym2 edges, Corollary-22 decompositions, appending, cherries, splitting (S), closing (C). It is the largest single piece of s4 and it is repeated with variations in PV and VX+ ('exactly as in the proof of Lemma TPV'). Recommendation: one Lib step engine, parametrised by the retiring set W, the next active set U+, the class family, the reserved edges and an arc selector (PV), proving: outputs are cycles/single edges, pairwise edge-disjoint, covering F_j plus the connector edges, with the per-step cost bound; then three thin instantiations. Without it the effort roughly doubles.

hazards.label: TPV-SIZE-PRED
hazards.description: 'N >= N0' is circular with s1:defConstants (N0 is defined through the size conditions of this proof). The Spec must take the explicit Defs predicate TPVSize N (L >= 2^10, N >= L^3, eta_TPV(N) <= 1/100) and s1's N0Cond must include it (s1 blueprint CONST-N0-INPROOF; naming EG.S4.TPVSize there vs EG.Vortex.TPVSize here must be unified). I checked that every inequality the proof uses beyond (i)-(iv) (J >= 1, k <= L, 2 + b <= t, m*3/L^2 >= 12, s >= 40kL, s/(2k) >= 2^145 L^41, N > 1 for EG0 and HB) follows from (i)-(iv) and the s-threshold; no hidden size condition was found.

hazards.label: TPV-MC-LIB
hazards.description: (G2) needs three new Lib results: (1) the law of V_{j,c} (a function of (lev, kappa), with chi fixed) is EG.FinDist.indepSubset Z q with q_v in {1/6, 2^{-(j+1)}/6} (pushforward of a product along per-vertex coordinate blocks; map_pi_of_dependsOn exists); (2) (MC): for an upward-closed family K ⊆ 2^S, P(indepSubset S q ∉ K) <= P(rsubset S rho ∉ K) whenever q >= rho pointwise (coordinatewise monotonicity of Psi_K; ~150 lines); (3) the Fubini step 'P(G1 and not G2) <= sum_chi P(chi) * ...' on the product colouring x (lev, kappa). Also needed: the upward closure of K_{j,c} = s3:lemMonotone(ii) (EG.FGraph.IsPathConnected.mono exists in Lib).

hazards.label: TPV-UNREVIEWED
hazards.description: The per-step bound (12|W_j| + 9|P ∩ U_j|), the finish (EG0(b), beta = 48) and the final count (84 + 48 = 132 <= 169) are new in v6 (R1), and the truncated level law, (MC) and (B) are new in v6 (R5); none has a referee. I re-derived all of them: (eqTPVJ), (eqTPVt) 2 + b <= 2^8 L^8 + 2^8 L^2 + 3 <= 2^10 L^8, the T16* threshold 2^135 * 2^10 L^8 * L^28 * L^5 = 2^145 L^41 <= 2^149 L^41, the failure bound 2^96 L^30 N^-3, P(I_u = 1) >= (1/L)(6/L)(1/2) = 3/L^2, (B) with m'p >= 3L^4 >= 12, Markov for (G5), (P1)-(P4) (the far-end count: at most one of e^{c,1}_w, e^{c,2}_w has far end x, and x in A(w) for <= b vertices w), (P3) length >= 2, the invariant persistence, and the cost; no error found. Residual risk is in the informal edge bookkeeping (TPV-ENGINE-SIZE).

hazards.label: TPV-COLOUR-TYPE
hazards.description: Colours are named R_{j,c}, M; EG.Spec.L15pStatement is stated for EG.FinDist.randColouring with Fin k. Use the colour type Option (Fin J x Fin 3) and a Lib transport lemma (uniform colourings correspond under an Equiv of colour types; L15+ per-class bound is invariant), or colour with Fin (3J+1) and a fixed bijection. Only proof-internal with the deterministic Spec.

hazards.label: TPV-LOOPLESS-E
hazards.description: E is 'an edge set ... all of whose edges have both ends in Z' of a SIMPLE graph (Convention s1:convGraphs); a raw Finset (Sym2 V) may contain loops, which no decomposition covers. The Spec must add ∀ e ∈ E, ¬ e.IsDiag (T0 record, as for EG0(b)). The consumer's E = Erem(Z) ⊆ E(G) is loopless.

hazards.label: TPV-T4-VACUOUS
hazards.description: (T4) ('no arcs', 'every path is closed within its step') is a property of the procedure; its only formal content is that the objects are cycles/single edges with edges in E, which IsDecomp EV D with EV ⊆ E already expresses. s6:thmMIXC uses (T3)+(T4) only as 'O_T decomposes ⊔_Z E^V(Z)'. No separate conjunct.

hazards.label: TPV-T3-EMPTY
hazards.description: 'E^V = ∅ if P = ∅' is implied by the count bound 169*|P| = 0 plus IsDecomp; no separate conjunct needed (keep a derived lemma for consumers).

hazards.label: TPV-AW-INTERNAL
hazards.description: The statement fixes the HB family A(w) 'as a function of O only' (the lexicographically first one). It enters only the definition of the good event (G4) and (P4); in the deterministic Spec it disappears. In Lean use Classical.choose of the HB Spec; 'lexicographically first' is not needed.

hazards.label: TPV-EPS-UPPER
hazards.description: eps_O <= 2^-5 is never used (the manuscript says so). Keep it in the Spec for faithfulness (the consumer passes eps = 2^-5) or drop it (a stronger Spec); either is fine.

hazards.label: TPV-REAL-T
hazards.description: t = 2^10 L^8 is real and IsPathConnected compares a natural count with it; (P4) gives count <= 2 + b (natural) and (eqTPVt) gives (2 + b : ℝ) <= t. Also ell = 2^12 L^4 is real; connector lengths are not used later.

hazards.label: TPV-T16-FIXED-X

The proof conditions on the colouring (fix chi in (G1)); the T16* Spec (s3 blueprint) must be usable on the separate space rsubset Z (1/L) for a fixed FGraph X with X.card = N; no independence clause between X and V' is then needed.

hazards.label: TPV-SIMPLE-TRAILS
hazards.description: (S) uses that a trail in a simple graph cannot return after 1 or 2 steps (no loops, no repeated edge), so every split-off cycle has length >= 3 = Obj.WF for Obj.cycle (Nodup, length >= 3). The Lean trail must carry 'edges pairwise distinct' and 'no loop edges'; the latter follows from E loopless.

hazards.label: TPV-STAGE-ALPHA

name: Lemma PV (the four-phase P-vortex)
ms_status: x2+RT for the constant 369; the ext-formulation x0; (c) changed by CR1-PV: x1; per-step bound (s4:eqPVstep), finish and count (a) changed in v6 (R1): no referee yet; level law truncated, (G2) via (MC), (B) re-proved in v6 (R5): no referee yet
formalization: Spec (deterministic form) EG/Spec/Vortex/PV.lean: PVStatement; proof EG/Proof/Vortex/PV.lean from the shared Lib engine (s4:lemTPV) plus arcs, phases and the stripping finish
statement: HYPOTHESES (all fixed, not random). Z a finite vertex set, N := |Z|, L := log_2 N, N >= N0 (Lean: PVSize N: L >= 2^10, N >= L^3, eta_PV(N) <= 1/100). J := floor(log2(L/8)), m := ceil(L^6), b := ceil(2^7 L^2 m), t := 2^9 L^8. (1) O a graph with V(O) = Z, a (2^-6, s_O)-expander with 2m <= s_O; sets A(w) ⊆ N_O(w) (w in Z), |A(w)| = m, every vertex in at most b of the sets A(w) (w in Z). (2) Own classes: graphs R_{j,c} (0 <= j < J, c in [4]) and M, each with vertex set Z and a (2^-6, s')-expander, s' >= 2^145 L^41, pairwise edge-disjoint (all 4J+1 of them, M included). (3) A partition Z = Rt + Pl (rooted / parentless). (4) A map ext : Z -> [4] u {*}. (E1') For every w in Pl, the set C_w := {wu : u in A(w), wu in E(M), ext(u) = *} has |C_w| >= L^5/8. LABELS (independent): for v in Pl a level lev(v) in {0..J}, P(lev >= j) = 2^-j (0 <= j <= J); for v in Z a label kappa(v) in {0,...,4}, P(0) = 1/2, P(c) = 1/8 (c in [4]). SETS: U_j := Rt u {v in Pl : lev v >= j}, W_j := {v in Pl : lev v = j}, Z_j := {u in U_{j+1} : kappa u = 0}, V_{j,c} := {u in U_{j+1} : kappa u = c}. GOOD EVENT G_PV := (G2) every R_{j,c} is (2^12 L^4, t)-path connected through V_{j,c} and (G4) for all j < J, w in Pl, C^j_w := {wu in C_w : u in Z_j} has >= 8 elements and (G5) sum_{j<J} |Pl ∩ U_j| <= 8|Pl| and |Pl ∩ U_J| <= 64|Pl|/L. CLAIM 1: G_PV is determined by the own classes, the A(w), the partition, ext and the labels, and P(G_PV) >= 1/2 - eta_PV(N), eta_PV(N) := 2^95 L^31 N^-3 + N L e^{-L^4/16} <= 1/100. CLAIM 2: on G_PV, for EVERY edge set H_0 of a simple graph with all ends in Z that contains E(M) and every E(R_{j,c}), there EXIST a partition H_0 = H^obj + H^arc and a family A of paths (arcs) such that (a) H^obj decomposes into at most 369|Pl| objects; (b) H^arc is the disjoint union of the edge sets of the arcs; the arcs are pairwise edge-disjoint paths of length >= 1 with two distinct ends, both in Rt, each carrying a phase c in [4] such that every vertex x of a phase-c arc (ends included) has ext(x) ≠ c; (c) |A| <= 4(J+1)N, and every vertex x is an end of at most deg_{H_0}(x) <= |Z| - 1 arcs; (d) Rt = ∅ implies A = ∅; Pl = ∅ implies H^obj = ∅. Meta-claim: all outputs are a deterministic function of (H_0, labels). LOGICAL CONTENT: Claim 2's conclusion does not mention the labels, so (as for TPV) Claims 1+2 imply the deterministic statement 'for every admissible H_0 there are H^obj, A with (a)-(d)', and that deterministic statement is all any consumer uses. Proof outline: TPV's procedure with rooted vertices never retiring; 8 reserved M-edges per w in W_j with far ends having kappa = 0 and ext = *; phases avoiding kappa(x), ext(x), ext(w); paths not from cherries with both ends in Rt become arcs (P5), all others are closed by connectors; per-step cost <= 28|Pl ∩ U_j| (224|Pl| in total by (G5)); finish: edges inside Pl_J := Pl ∩ U_J by EG0(b) (beta = 64) at <= 64|Pl|; the other edges (each with an end in Rt) get a phase avoiding ext of both ends, Corollary-22 paths per phase, stripping of end edges at Pl_J (<= 8|Pl_J| <= 8|Pl| single edges; the manuscript keeps the looser 16|Pl|), remainders become arcs; total 304|Pl| <= 369|Pl|.

The statement additionally DEFINES G_PV explicitly and bounds its probability (Claim 1), which is genuine but consumer-irrelevant content: keep it as a Lib lemma (or a separate Tier-2 PVGoodStatement) and lock the deterministic PVStatement. s5:lemChild's conclusion 'conditional probability given stage 1 >= 1/3' then has no Lean counterpart; the s5 blueprint must be told.

The PV versions differ: (Inv2)/(Inv3) say 'lies in H_j' (H_0 contains all own classes) instead of 'unused'; U_j contains Rt, which never retires, so path ends can be rooted; reserved edges always lie in F_j (no Q side); phases avoid three values (kappa(x), ext(x), ext(w)); (P5) is new; arcs are selected instead of closed; the multiset closed by (G2) is a SUBset of PathsQ_{j,c}. label: s4:thmVXp
name: Theorem VX+ (sharpened vortex absorption with arbitrary extra edges)
ms_status: x2+RT; displayed bound, finish and count changed in v6 (R1): no referee yet; level law truncated, (G2) via (MC), (B) re-proved in v6 (R5): no referee yet
formalization: Spec (deterministic form) EG/Spec/Vortex/VX.lean: VXStatement (+ corollary fnum <= 80N); proof EG/Proof/Vortex/VX.lean from the shared Lib engine plus the parity/flexible-edge mechanism
statement: HYPOTHESES. Z a finite vertex set, N := |Z|, L := log_2 N, N >= N0 (Lean: VXSize N: L >= 2^10, N >= L^3, eta_VX(N) <= 1/100). O a graph with V(O) = Z that is an (eps_O, s)-expander with EITHER eps_O = 2^-5 and s >= 2^146 L^38 log_2 L, OR eps_O = 2^-6 and s >= 2^151 L^38 log_2 L. PARAMETERS: J := floor(log2(L/6)), k := 3J+1, m := ceil(L^3), b := ceil(2 m L^2/eps_O) (= ceil(64 L^2 m) resp. ceil(128 L^2 m)), t := 2^8 L^5 resp. 2^9 L^5. LABELS (independent): a uniform colouring of E(O) with the k colours R_{j,c} (j < J, c in [3]) and M; for EVERY v in Z a level lev(v) in {0..J}, P(lev >= j) = 2^-j (0 <= j <= J); for every v in Z a label kappa(v) in {0,1,2,3}, P(0) = 1/2, P(c) = 1/6. CLAIM: there is an event G_VX, determined by O and the labels, with P(G_VX) >= 1 - eta_VX(N) >= 1/2, eta_VX(N) := 2 L N^-5 + 2^95 L^28 N^-3 + N L e^{-3L^2/(32 log_2 L)} + L e^{-N/(5000 L)}, such that on G_VX, SIMULTANEOUSLY for EVERY graph G with V(G) = Z and E(O) ⊆ E(G) (other edges arbitrary), E(G) has a decomposition into at most 38.4N + 13N <= 52N <= 80N objects, all cycles except at most N + 13N/L single edges; in particular f(G) <= 80N. LOGICAL CONTENT: the conclusion is label-free, so the theorem is equivalent to its deterministic form 'for every such G there is a decomposition with <= 52N objects and <= N + 13N/L single edges'. Explicit good event: (G1) all colour classes are spanning (eps_O, s/(2k))-expanders; (G2) every R_{j,c} is (2^12 L^4, t)-path connected through V_{j,c}; (G3) |U_j| <= 1.01 * 2^-j N for 0 <= j <= J; (G4) for all j < J and w in Z, C^j_w := {wu : u in A(w), wu in M, u in Z_j} has >= 9 elements (A = Lemma-HB family of O with m = ceil(L^3)). Proof outline: per step j: (a) parity edge for w in W_j with odd deg_{F_j}(w); (b) 6 reserved + 2 flexible edges per w; (c) classes avoiding kappa of the other end, flexible edges fix the parities so deg_{F_{j,c}}(w) is even; (d) Cor-22 paths (each w an end of 0 or 2 paths by (E)); (e) append/cherries, (S), (P1)-(P4) with 2 + b <= t; (f) close by connectors; step cost <= 19|U_j|; total over steps <= 19 * 1.01 * N * sum 2^-j <= 38.4N; finish by EG0(b) (beta = 13, alpha = N, W = U_J, |U_J| <= 13N/L) at <= 13N objects with <= 13N/L single edges; single edges overall: <= N parity edges + <= 13N/L.

hazards.label: VX-PARITY-MECHANISM
hazards.description: Steps (a)-(d) rely on a parity argument not needed in TPV: parity edges have exactly one end in W_j (so they fix the parity at w without disturbing other w'); chosen edges of w' are not incident to w ∈ W_j (their far ends lie in U_{j+1}); hence d_1(w)+d_2(w)+d_3(w) = deg_{F'_j}(w) - 8 (an edge with both ends in W_j counts at both); flexible edges fix the two odd d_c; then (E)'s parity part (number of paths of a path decomposition ending at w ≡ deg(w) mod 2) plus Cor 22 (<= 2) gives 0 or 2 ends at w, so the d = 1 case of TPV never occurs. I re-derived all of it; correct. The parity part of (E) must be a Lib lemma (the s1 blueprint lists it under Cor 22).

label: s4:remTPVVX
name: Lemma TPV as a vortex-absorption statement; not used by the main argument
formalization: Not formalized as a Spec (the manuscript says it is not used). Optional Lib corollary tpv_absorb from TPVStatement with P := Z
statement: Let O be a spanning (eps_O, s)-expander on Z, N = |Z| >= N0, eps_O in [2^-7, 2^-5], s >= 2^150 L^42. Applying s4:lemTPV with P := Z, Q := ∅: on G_TPV, for every edge set E ⊇ E(O) inside Z, (T1) gives E^V = E and (T3) gives a decomposition of E into at most 169N objects. So TPV contains an absorption statement like VX+ with 169 in place of 80 and threshold 2^150 L^42 in place of 2^146 L^38 log_2 L (resp. 2^151 L^38 log_2 L); for eps_O = 2^-6 both apply once s >= 2^150 L^42 (since L^4 >= 2 log_2 L). Consequently either result may be used wherever VX+ is applied to an expander meeting TPV's threshold; only the coefficient of the vertex mass changes. VX+ is applied only to parts whose total mass enters the final bound through a term eps n with eps = eps(D_*) -> 0, so the choice affects no constant of the cost line. The remark is not used in the proofs.
deps_notes: The first part is a direct instance of s4:lemTPV ((T1) with P = Z makes E^V = E; (T3)). The comparison with s4:thmVXp is arithmetic (2^150 L^42 >= 2^151 L^38 log_2 L iff L^4 >= 2 log_2 L). The claim about how VX+ mass enters the final bound is a forward pointer to s5:lemExpect / s7:propCost (the 'dem' term), not checked here and not a dependency.
